evidence.claim: ContractHostTag admits div, main, nav, ul, ol, form, section and aside. `details` is absent, so a disclosure cannot be a contract host and must be a leaf.
The sticky family in LayoutClassName exists only in its first-child form, so a right-hand sticky rail widens the union by five mirrored members.
routed-page-main already carries host: main, so the page landmark is a locked entry rather than anything this run proposes.
PressableTree, SurfaceCard, SurfaceFormCard, SurfaceListCard, SurfacePanel, Tree. There is still no accordion branch, and the Main branch a previous run proposed has been deleted.
Copy resolves through next-intl and src/resources does not exist here, so no-second-language-in-source is already satisfied by the repository's habit and constrains no direction.
No /courses/[displayId] route exists, and src/modules/api/graphql/queries holds no single-course document.
CourseRequest accepts id OR displayId, so the production slug resolves with no new backend field.
The five trust chips are derived client-side by walking modules to contents to challenges and minutesRead; no backend counter is involved, but the page must fetch the whole module tree.
The rail is the only buy box and the hero deliberately carries no price or CTA.
The superseded run selected the same posture but mapped it before ContractHostTag existed, which is why its feasibility list names a Main branch that no longer exists.

unknowns: The target has no single-course query. The document that feeds this page must carry the whole module tree, because the five trust chips are derived from it rather than read from a counter.
Cart and checkout are absent from the target, so the CTA's destination beyond enrolment is unproven.
pageNumber base: the backend documents PaginationPageFilters.pageNumber as 1-based while the legacy hook passes 0-based. It does not affect this page and it does affect the catalog that links here.
Whether a buyer needs lesson-level detail before purchase. Direction A assumes yes because the named render discloses; direction B was offered precisely to make that assumption visible.

contracts.why: LOCKED and already carries host: main. The routed page is the one region a reader came for, so it is the document's landmark.
LOCKED. The payable price leads while original price and discount qualify that same commerce fact on one wrapping line.
LOCKED. Carries the sticky mechanics on its FIRST child, which is why parity needs a mirror rather than this key.
The narrative owns the flexible measure while the purchase decision keeps a fixed sticky column at the trailing edge.
host aside. The buy box is complementary to the narrative rather than part of it, which is what an aside means and what a screen reader announces.
host ol. Modules are ordered - module three follows module two - and an ol says so to a reader who cannot see the numbering.
host ul. Unordered peers of one joined list; deliberately not profile-evidence-list, whose identical mechanics are named for a different domain.
host ul. A course's trust counts are compact peer facts that wrap together; a course's evidence is not a profile's topics.
The phases are one mutually exclusive ladder in which the open phase is the price and the others are the cost of waiting.
Below the rail's breakpoint the purchase decision would scroll away entirely, so price and action pin to the bottom edge and step aside as soon as the rail can hold them.
